title: Signed-connectome reproduction, male-cns:v0.9 depth-2 subgraph (run-006)

inputs.dataset: male-cns:v0.9 (live MaleCNS lineage; v1.0 removed from server)
inputs.matrix: connectivity_matrix_signed.npz (47,889 neurons; 1,278,154 signed edges; E:I weight 2.00)

protocol.seeds: 42-71, one paired trial per seed per arm
protocol.differing_conditions: seed only; both arms on identical signed inputs (verified after catching a matrix-asymmetry launch bug)

tost.method: TOST, Welch df, pre-specified band ±10% of reference mean

results.n_spiking: 2 of 47,889 (0.004%) in both arms - GABAergic seed pair; near-local suppression is the correct prediction

e_i_audit.sign_model: w = nt_sign(source) * synapse_count * w_syn; sign strictly per presynaptic neuron

evidence_from_authors_data.conclusion: sign is a per-neuron NT property, matching NT-identity semantics

nt_sign_convention.status: CONVENTION-INFERRED, not derived from the authors' NT table (not shipped). Externally anchored by WP6c (behavioral reproduction).

unknown_nt_default_audit.composition: dominated by low-degree sensory classes (mechanosensory 697, unknown_sensory 432, gustatory 271, olfactory 118)
unknown_nt_default_audit.conclusion: under-represented among hubs; minimal structural leverage on propagation

limitations: NT-to-sign mapping is standard convention (ACh +, GABA/glutamate -), not the authors' actual assignment; validated structurally (per-neuron uniformity in their data) but not externally. WP6c exists to close this.
Unknown-NT neurons (12.5%) default to excitatory; audited as low-leverage (under-represented among hubs, median 2 partners).
run-005 (male-cns:v1.0) results rest on a server-removed dataset; raw data preserved and checksummed (data/checksums/run-005_raw_sha256.json) but not re-fetchable.
Both arms share the NT-sign convention; head-to-head agreement validates implementation parity, not the convention itself.

history.run-005_unsigned_note: run-005's WP6 pass remains valid as an implementation check but its inputs lacked sign; its biological numbers (6K spikes, 447 spikers) were produced by an all-excitatory distortion of the connectome.
history.run-006_unsigned_rejected: the 44%-of-network cascade on unsigned run-006 was the same distortion at scale, not biology.
